race.title: Midnite Built Different Handicap (Div 1)
race.verdict: LABICHE made a promising start to life with James Owen when fourth at Wolverhampton on Monday and turned out quickly, could be the answer. Jenson Benson and Far Far Out are in-form rivals, while Saahir could be a different proposition returned to all-weather. LABICHE JENSON BENSON (IRE) FAR FAR OUT (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Labiche (4/1), Jenson Benson (5/1), Far Far Out (6/1), This Rib (8/1), Saahir (10/1), Bennyworth (10/1), Lady Aiyana (12/1), Lapidarist (12/1), Celtic Spirit (12/1), Gifts Differing (14/1), Poke The Bear (16/1), Liberty Bird (20/1), Echo That (25/1), Muy Muy Loco (25/1)
